title: Terraria use-style vocabulary from data (use_styles.json + data migration)
player_outcome: Every item uses the right body action. Boss summons, crystals and mirrors are held up; food is eaten; potions are drunk; boomerangs, shuriken and bombs are thrown; guns (including magic guns) are held like guns; staffs point and tomes are read. Yoyos, flails and whips each have their own style.
design: Verified: UseStyle is { None, Swing, Thrust, Shoot, Hold, Consume, Place } (ItemDef.cs:15-18). Data uses swing 151, shoot 129, consume 54, thrust 22, place 1, hold 0. PlayerAvatar.ActionFor (Motion.cs:272-281) guesses 8 clips.

Replace the enum with { None, Swing, Rapier, Spear, Shoot, Gun, Bow, Staff, Tome, Throw, Yoyo, Flail, Whip, HoldUp, Drink, Eat, Place }. JSON uses camelCase names (holdUp). Thrust, Hold and Consume are removed after migration.

New Core Gameplay/Items/UseStyleRules.cs, part 1 (implied actions). Swing adds Melee only when DamageType == Melee, so summon staves and fishing rods don't melee. Rapier and Spear add Thrust. Shoot, Gun, Bow, Staff, Tome, Throw, Yoyo and Flail add Shoot when the item has a projectile or useAmmo. Whip adds Melee for now (P3-14 switches it to Whip). Drink, Eat and HoldUp add Consume when the item heals, buffs, or has consume/loot behaviours.

UseStyleRules, part 2: Infer(item, actions) resolves None. Tools → Swing, placers → Place, heal/buff → Drink, the well_fed buff → Eat, useAmmo arrow → Bow, other ammo → Gun, magic with projectile → Staff.
ItemUseTable.Resolve uses UseStyleRules and stores the result in a new ItemUseInfo.Style (never None for usable items).

New data/config/use_styles.json with one entry per style: clip (3P action name), armAim (AimModifier weight), hand {offset, euler} (grip frame, used by P3-06), holdout {forward, right, down} in metres (shot origin, used by P3-09), fp {...} (reserved for P3-07), and for swing a bladeCurve [[t, deg, ease], ...] seeded from actions.py (used by P3-04).

New Core Presentation/UseStyleConfig.cs (Load/Validate/Fallback, same pattern as GraphicsConfig). Every enum value must have an entry, curves must be increasing in t, and clip names non-empty. Hook it into tools/Strata.Tools/Commands/ValidateCommand.cs and GameRoot boot validation. GameWorld.Styles is set by WorldLauncher; TestGame loads the real file from TestPaths.ProjectRoot.

Migrate the data with a one-off in-session script (not committed; no mapping table in the repo). It must scan ALL data/**/*.json, since items live in enemy packs too (terra_blade in enemies/temple.json, ball_o_hurt in enemies/evil.json). Update tools/content/gen_ore_tiers.py: shortswords 'rapier', bows 'bow'. Regenerate data/items/generated/ore_tiers.json.
ContentValidator.Items: generalise the shoot rule to every shooting style. Warn when a weapon, tool or consumable resolves to None. Error when yoyo/flail/whip items lack damage.
Game: PlayerAvatar.ActionFor(item, info) returns _game.Styles.Clip(info.Style), falling back to 'use'. AimModifier.ArmAim comes from the style's armAim. Delete the old heuristic.
